headline: Trading cards, circus skills and small local adventures
summary: Five different ideas for 12–13 September, plus a free after-school sport to try this week. Choose the date and age that work for you.

notices.title: Techniquest maintenance closure
notices.detail: Closed 7–10 September. Toddler Day reopens on Friday 11 September, 09:00–16:00.

notices.title: National Museum Cardiff closes on Mondays
notices.detail: The regular opening days are Tuesday–Sunday, 10:00–17:00. Check the museum page for changes.

notices.title: Museum of Cardiff is temporarily closed
notices.detail: The museum reports a leak and has not announced a reopening date. Check its own page before travelling.

datedPicks.description: Share a story, then make something inspired by it at this neighbourhood library session.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Listed weekly on Mondays and Thursdays. Check with the hub before a special trip.
datedPicks.appeal: A story with something to make afterwards, in one manageable hour.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Our guide: preschool and early primary with an adult; the hub gives no exact age range.

datedPicks.title: Baby Rhyme Time
datedPicks.location: Penylan Library and Community Centre, Penylan Road, Penylan CF23 5HW
datedPicks.description: Songs and gentle movement for babies who are not yet walking.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Organiser: for babies not yet walking. Contact Penylan Library 02920 788413 if unsure.
datedPicks.appeal: A short, simple outing built around your baby’s stage.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Babies who are not yet walking, with a parent or carer.
datedPicks.parentTip: The organiser specifies pre-walkers. Penylan Library can help with questions on 02920 788413.

datedPicks.title: Story and Rhyme Time
datedPicks.location: Canton Library, Library Street, Canton CF5 1QD
datedPicks.description: Stories, rhymes and games together, with time to choose a library book afterwards.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Welsh-language session is Fridays at the same venue pattern — check the Hub page.
datedPicks.appeal: A half-hour of stories and rhymes without a long outing.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Our guide: preschool and early primary with an adult; no exact age range is published.
datedPicks.parentTip: Monday is the English session. A Welsh session is listed for Fridays; check its time separately.

datedPicks.title: Mini Wildlings at Techniquest Toddler Day
datedPicks.location: Techniquest, Stuart Street, Cardiff Bay CF10 5BW
datedPicks.cost: Adult £15.45 + age 3–4 £13.63; under-3s free. Optional Star Stories £2/child.
datedPicks.description: Flossy and Boo bring songs and make-believe to a preschool-only day. Mini Wildlings is included in admission but needs its own advance reservation.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Book admission and a Mini Wildlings space. Prices shown exclude the optional donation.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: paid · book ahead on Techniquest tickets
datedPicks.appeal: A guided story-making session for toddlers who like to move and join in.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Preschool children; older children do not have their usual access on Toddler Day.
datedPicks.parentTip: An adult with an under-3 pays £15.45; with a 3–4-year-old, £29.08 before optional extras. Book the Mini Wildlings session separately.

datedPicks.title: Circus skills & butter-making at the Food Festival
datedPicks.location: St Fagans National Museum of History, Cardiff CF5 6XB
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · parking £7 · some activities paid
datedPicks.description: Try circus skills, watch traditional butter-making and follow the family trail between food stalls. These activities are part of the annual St Fagans Food Festival.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Check the programme for activity times. Parking £7; some activities and food cost extra.
datedPicks.appeal: Give them something to try and discover while you explore the food stalls.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: All ages welcome; Our guide: ages 5–12 for the activities, with younger siblings along.
datedPicks.parentTip: Butter-making finishes at 15:00; circus sessions have breaks. Arrive after 14:00 for a quieter visit.

datedPicks.title: Cardiff Brick Festival
datedPicks.location: National Indoor Athletics Centre, Cyncoed Campus, 9 Cyncoed Rd, Cardiff CF23 6XD
datedPicks.cost: Adult £8 · child 5–12 £6 · family of four £22 on ticket listing · under-5s free with adult; check booking fees.
datedPicks.description: Build at the communal tables, see large LEGO displays and sign up for a timed building challenge. There are also traders selling bricks and sets.
datedPicks.parentHeadsUp: Speed-build places are limited: sign up on arrival. Standard tickets enter from 11:00.
datedPicks.appeal: For a child who wants to build as well as look at impressive models.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Our guide: LEGO fans aged 5–12. Under-5s can enter free with a paying adult.
datedPicks.parentTip: Standard entry starts at 11:00. Early entry is £15 from 10:00 on the ticket listing. Organiser pages disagree on family prices (£20/£22), so check the booking total.

datedPicks.title: Trading cards & retro games at Canopi
datedPicks.location: The Canopi, 59–61 Tudor Street, Cardiff CF11 6AD
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · buying cards is optional
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Our guide: card and gaming fans aged 8–12 with an adult; no organiser age limit stated.
datedPicks.description: A local collectors’ afternoon with a trading room, space for trading-card games and vintage consoles. Free entry makes it easy to have a look before committing to anything.
datedPicks.appeal: Take your card-game fan somewhere they can meet other enthusiasts and explore older consoles.
datedPicks.parentTip: Stay with your child and agree a swap or spending limit before they bring their cards.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: free entry · no booking link listed

datedPicks.title: Wild West play party at Goodsheds
datedPicks.cost: £18.70 for one child + one adult on booking page · extra adults £2 advertised
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Our guide: preschool and early primary. Organiser welcomes all ages; an adult must stay.
datedPicks.description: Songs, dancing, bubbles and parachute play, finishing with cowboy-boot decorating and a character photo opportunity.
datedPicks.appeal: A lively morning for younger children who enjoy pretending, moving and making.
datedPicks.parentTip: Book ahead. Allow £18.70 for the child-and-adult ticket, above the £17 advertised headline.

datedPicks.title: Try softball & baseball in St Mellons
datedPicks.location: St Mellons Hub, 30 Crickhowell Road, Cardiff CF3 0EF
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: ages 9–13; younger children only by prior arrangement.
datedPicks.description: A weekly youth softball and baseball session with the equipment supplied, so you can try a different sport without buying a bat or glove.
datedPicks.appeal: An after-school chance to try a sport they may never have played.
datedPicks.parentTip: The hub lists this every Wednesday. Call 029 2078 1064 to confirm this week’s session and meeting point before travelling.

datedPicks.title: Free LEGO hour at Penylan Library
datedPicks.location: Penylan Library and Community Centre, Penylan Road, Cardiff CF23 5HW
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Ages 2+ (organiser). Our guide: best for younger builders with an adult.
datedPicks.description: An hour to build something of your own at the local library’s weekly LEGO club.
datedPicks.appeal: A simple free building session when a big ticketed day feels like too much.
datedPicks.parentTip: The library lists this weekly. Confirm it’s running before making a special trip.

evergreen.title: National Museum Cardiff
